executive_assessment.text: Coastal zones with over 60% of the population face sea-level rise, erosion, and salt intrusion; yields declined an estimated 1.2% annually since 2010 amid erratic rain and drought.

geographic_notes.text: The Gambia; coastal areas: Coastal zones with over 60% of the population face sea-level rise, erosion, and salt intrusion; yields declined an estimated 1.2% annually since 2010 amid erratic rain and drought.

Greater Banjul; North Bank Region; Central River Region; Upper River Region: The rapid assessment estimated that the 2022 floods affected 50,378 people and displaced 7,404 across Greater Banjul, North Bank, Central River, and Upper River regions.

Greater Banjul; Rural areas: The assessment reports that floods breached water and sewage systems and contaminated water bodies. Greater Banjul had the largest number affected, while rural communities were described as more vulnerable.
